LESSON: CHRISTIAN MORAL VALUES: PURITY

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible Selected Teachings
Topic 2.1: Christian Moral Values: Purity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Christian Moral Values: Purity
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify moral values that a young person should uphold
2. describe forbidden sexual practises outlined in the Bible

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Christian Moral Values: Purity

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Christian Moral Values: Purity

Teach
• Focus skill: identify moral values that a young person should uphold.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Christian Moral Values: Purity.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Christian Moral Values: Purity
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how one can avoid being lured to same-sex relationships, 1. How can you live a morally upright life?
2. Why should you maintain sexual purity as a Christian youth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
